t1.text: Desktop app: one home, three places

t3.text: In the call, and contacts reaching in

s1.text:
IA (cast-d2o)

Home gets a left nav: Rooms, Contacts, Settings. Account/person stuff leaves the rooms list and moves to Settings > You and your devices.

Rooms: one primary action per room (Join), link copy as an icon, everything else in a ... menu. Past calls fold under a disclosure. Rooms you joined on other hosts sit below your own, with live status.

Theme moves into Settings > Appearance (and the in-call ... menu) as a standard segmented control.

s2.text:
Contacts epic finished (cast-40e)

.2 pairing: Add contact (code) + requests inbox
.3 presence: dot + 'In a call' / 'Last seen'
.4 contact link: invisible plumbing; surfaces only as 'Files waiting' on a contact
.5 invites: Invite button here and in call; tray toast
.6 revocation: Settings > Your devices > Remove
.7 auto-link: no UI at all (call window just is you)
.9 sync contacts: no UI; same list on every install
.10 add from call: People row menu + incoming prompt
.11 room trust: a room's People (New room step + Room settings > People)

s3.text:
Lobby / leave (walkthrough 3, 6, 9)

Camera preview and a live mic meter before joining. Password field only when the room has one. Empty name is required, never GuestE048.

Leave gets a real 'You left' moment: delivery progress up front, Rejoin and Back to your calls. No more landing in the waiting room.

s4.text:
Call (walkthrough 1, 4, 5, 7)

Top bar is one row and never reflows when a take starts: the REC pill has a fixed slot.

People panel speaks plainly: Host / Producer / Guest chips, icons for recording, space left and connection. Developer detail (guest #, dBFS, LAN only, take state) goes under Connection details.

Room settings collapsed; sync shows as progress bars.

Phone: labelled dock, Leave always visible, panels open as sheets that never cover the REC pill.

s5.text:
A room's people = trust, not an invite

Contacts added to a room (when creating it, or later from the room's ... > Room settings > People) are trusted persons of that room (room.json persons, cast-40e.11): every device of theirs gets in even when the room is locked, sees the room in its list with live status, and is told the call link.

Optional per person: Producer.

Inviting to a live call stays a separate one-off action (Invite).
